acceptance_checks.given: an active Jin-owned non-recurring plain Event
acceptance_checks.then: core SHALL report it editable and the detail SHALL expose Edit
acceptance_checks.verify_method: test: cargo test -p jin-core event_detail_capabilities plus GUI detail test

acceptance_checks.given: an active Jin-owned non-recurring Time block
acceptance_checks.then: core SHALL report it editable without granting any originating-Task mutation
acceptance_checks.verify_method: test: core capability matrix and Time block edit preservation

acceptance_checks.given: a Google-authoritative, recurring, or cancelled Event
acceptance_checks.then: Edit SHALL be absent and no edit command SHALL be accepted
acceptance_checks.verify_method: test: core policy matrix plus GUI action absence

acceptance_checks.then: the same route, source label, Time block label when applicable, date context, and bounded reading width SHALL remain stable
canonical data SHALL remain unchanged and focus SHALL return to Edit in reading state
acceptance_checks.verify_method: test: GUI keyboard and cancel contract

acceptance_checks.given: edit state contains no changed editable field
acceptance_checks.then: no canonical write, sequence increment, index refresh, or sync enqueue SHALL occur
acceptance_checks.verify_method: test: core/bridge no-op edit side effects

acceptance_checks.when: Save is activated by click or Mod+Enter
acceptance_checks.then: exactly one edit operation SHALL begin and repeated activation while pending SHALL be ignored
acceptance_checks.verify_method: test: GUI input parity and pending guard

acceptance_checks.then: a newline SHALL be inserted and Save SHALL not run

acceptance_checks.given: a detail edit token and unchanged canonical Event
acceptance_checks.then: only allowed fields plus updated and sequence SHALL change
derived_from and every originating Task field SHALL remain unchanged

acceptance_checks.given: canonical Event bytes changed after detail load
acceptance_checks.then: core SHALL return a typed conflict without write, refresh, sync enqueue, or success notification
the draft SHALL remain intact, latest canonical detail SHALL be refetched for comparison, and neither conflict choice SHALL write
acceptance_checks.verify_method: test: GUI stale conflict draft preservation

acceptance_checks.then: core SHALL return the original semantic result without a second mutation

acceptance_checks.given: an incomplete edit operation with a divergent canonical hash
acceptance_checks.then: recovery SHALL block without overwrite, index refresh, or sync enqueue
GUI SHALL refetch canonical detail before success feedback, remain on detail, and restore focus to Edit
acceptance_checks.verify_method: test: GUI canonical refetch ordering and focus

acceptance_checks.given: validation, conflict, blocked, or retriable failure
acceptance_checks.then: the draft SHALL remain intact and localized accessible feedback SHALL identify the next safe action
acceptance_checks.verify_method: test: GUI typed failure matrix in en and pt-BR

acceptance_checks.given: any recurring master or occurrence including one with original_start
acceptance_checks.when: M2 capability projection or edit authorization runs
acceptance_checks.then: it SHALL remain view-only and edit SHALL be rejected without mutation or derived side effects
acceptance_checks.verify_method: test: core/bridge/GUI recurring edit rejection matrix

acceptance_checks.given: browser and native verification at supported widths, themes, scaling, languages, input modes, and reduced motion
acceptance_checks.then: primary actions SHALL remain reachable with no clipped content, unintended horizontal scrolling, console error, or keyboard trap
acceptance_checks.verify_method: evidence: Playwright MCP plus native Tauri owner sign-off
